subject: Bound the Gravity GPU weight cache (step-5 gap G1)
status: VERIFIED BY CLAUDE. Tests re-run independently. Not merged; end-to-end residency still unmeasured.
defect_closed: gpu::GpuWeightCache was an unbounded HashMap whose own comment said it keeps every touched tensor 'for the life of the model'. Against General-R0 that grows toward 82.6 GB of routed experts on a 96 GiB host, which is why BASE_TRUE_TPS was only ever measured over twelve decode tokens.

the_hazard_and_whether_it_was_handled.hazard: matvec_batch calls ensure() for every name BEFORE reading them all, so a naive LRU can evict a tensor an earlier ensure() in the SAME batch just inserted, and the batch then reads a hole.
the_hazard_and_whether_it_was_handled.how: BoundedLru::admit_pinned(items, pin) touches every pinned name first so LRU ordering cannot select it, then inserts, then evicts only unpinned entries. matvec and matvec_batch both route through ensure_many_locked under a single lock hold.
the_hazard_and_whether_it_was_handled.fails_loudly_rather_than_thrashing: A pinned working set larger than the whole budget returns an error naming the env var instead of evicting within the pin set; failed admission leaves no partial state.

budget.default_rationale: 32 GiB -- a real MoE working set on a 96 GiB unified-memory host without claiming the whole machine
budget.explicit_not_inferred: Correct choice. Inferring a budget from free RAM would have made residency depend on whatever else the machine happened to be running, which on this host is exactly the failure being avoided.

what_remains_unverified: Everything end-to-end. No run against the real 81 GB artifact, so the residency curve, the eviction rate under real routing, and any TPS effect are all unmeasured. The 30-hour pack owns the machine. This change is about not exhausting memory; whether it makes anything faster is a separate measurement nobody has taken.
next_action: When the box frees: measure cold, warm and the residency curve on General-R0 under this budget, then update BASE_TRUE_TPS with cold and warm reported separately (gap G2).
not_evidence_of: runtime residency behaviour on the real artifact, or any throughput change
